name: Create Snow
body:
School conjuration (creation, cold) [water]; Level druid 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect up to 2 gallons of snow/level
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell generates clean, unpolluted snow. Snow can be created in an area as small as will actually contain the snow, or in an area three times as large (possibly creating a downpour or filling many small receptacles).

Note: Conjuration spells cannot create substances or objects within a creature. Snow weighs about eight pounds per gallon. One cubic foot of snow contains roughly eight gallons and weighs about 60 pounds.
